title: Binance hot-wallet breach (~$6.3B, attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor; ~$3B frozen, Binance pledges to cover losses) drives BTC to a ~6-week low near $76.1-76.3k; ~$1.5B of mostly long liquidations
